shortDescription: Manages RADIUS auth configuration on a BIG-IP device

options.name: accounting_bug
options.description: Enables or disables validation of the accounting response vector. This option should be necessary only on older servers.

options.name: fallback_to_local
options.description: Specifies the system uses the Local authentication method if the remote authentication method is not available. Option only available on C(TMOS 13.0.0) and above.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: retries
options.description: Specifies the number of authentication retries the BIG-IP Local Traffic Management system allows before authentication fails.

options.name: servers
options.description: Specifies the names of RADIUS servers for use with RADIUS authentication profiles.

options.name: service_type
options.description: Specifies the type of service requested from the RADIUS server. The default value is C(authenticate-only).

options.name: state
options.description: When C(state) is C(present), ensures the RADIUS server exists. When C(state) is C(absent), ensures the RADIUS server is removed.

options.name: use_for_auth
options.description: Specifies whether or not this auth source is put in use on the system. If C(true), the module sets the current system auth type to the value of C(radius). If C(false), the module sets the authentication type to C(local), similar behavior to when C(state) is C(absent), without removing the configured RADIUS resource.
